description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValueEntity class, which extends CustomerOptionValue and implements Serializable. It adds additional properties like order and code, with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueEntity
classes.description: An entity class representing customer option values with additional fields order and code, and serializable support.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of the customer option value.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the customer option value.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the customer option value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with the customer option value.
